definition.name: Static site, examples and browser journeys

steps.name: Trust only the checked-out repository inside the owned container
Create a private native compiler cache inside the owned container
Install the reviewed website dependency graph without lifecycle scripts
steps.run:
python3 -m unittest discover -s website/toolchain/tests -v
python3 website/toolchain/prepare.py
npm ci --prefix website/toolchain --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
echo "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/website/toolchain/node_modules/.bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
node website/toolchain/node_modules/npm/bin/npm-cli.js ci --prefix website --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund

steps.name: Verify the selected package manager identity
Check metadata, source extraction, types and unit regressions
Build both supported static base paths
steps.run:
npm run build
npm run build:root

steps.name: Install the pinned test browser and its OS prerequisites
Verify production pages, theme and source-backed controls
steps.run:
# Each suite owns separate servers, browsers and evidence directories.
# Run the complete five-suite matrix concurrently on the hosted VM.
npm run test:versions &
versions_pid=$!
npm run test:build &
build_pid=$!
npm run test:theme &
theme_pid=$!
npm run test:examples &
examples_pid=$!
npm run test:discovery &
discovery_pid=$!
status=0
wait "$build_pid" || status=$?
wait "$theme_pid" || status=$?
wait "$examples_pid" || status=$?
wait "$discovery_pid" || status=$?
wait "$versions_pid" || status=$?
exit "$status"

steps.name: Retain only the tested site and compact browser receipts

reviewReason: Preserve complete workspace tests and every metadata/security qualification command, separating qualification onto a required fresh-inventory lane. Preserve both website builds and all five browser suites while using the digest-pinned official matching Noble image for preinstalled system libraries and fonts; exact project browser installation remains mandatory. Trust only the checkout workspace in this ephemeral container so Git operations work across the runner/container UID boundary; preserve repository path validation. Create a private mode-0700 SWC native materialization cache below the trusted sticky container temporary directory; retain native payload permission validation instead of using the host-mounted GitHub home. Union Root state-renderer/narrow-fixture assertions and every current-main owner/artifact/qualification obligation; retire only the duplicate obsolete source builder in favor of maintained byte-authenticated npm v4. Root reviewed obligation: Generate the authenticated local braces archive before the retained website npm installs; preserve all site and browser checks.
